sentences.text: ↵There is no way to save a password when logging into a Cisco IPSec VPN on a Macintosh operating system (macOS).

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: The best solution for me is writing an AppleScript in Automator, or running it from the command line, to automate the login process.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Open Apple's Automator,↵

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Choose New Document ↵

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Select Service ↵The service created has receives selected text by default.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: It means you need to select text or having focus in a text editor to enable the service.↵

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Try to search for action Run AppleScript .

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Then, drag the action into the right-hand-side.↵

sentences.text: The script uses scutil --nc status to check the VPN connection status, and scutil --nc start to initiate the VPN connection.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Typically, the VPN login dialog appears within 3 seconds.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: If your laptop is slow, please update the value in delay 3 .

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: To automate the process, try running the script using the play button and observe how it works.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Save the script with a name such as VPN Login .↵In the System Preferences -> Keyboard -> Shortcuts , you can find the automation script.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Assign a shortcut key.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: By default, the script is assigned to the Text service during its creation.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: To use the keyboard shortcut, you will need to select some text or have focus in a text editor enabled.↵

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: Try selecting text from a text editor, such as Atom.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: With the proper shortcut key set up, you should be able to automate the VPN login.

sourceRef.title: How to login Cisco VPN automatically on macOS High Sierra

sentences.text: This script should work with Sierra or earlier versions of macOS, although I haven't tested it on older systems myself.
